content: No official better-auth doc explicitly covers invite-only allowlisting, but the plugin's own documented behavior enables it directly: with disableSignUp:true, sendMagicLink still fires for ANY submitted email (doc: user 'will be signed up automatically unless disableSignUp is true' implies the request-time flow does not gate on existence). Standard pattern: inside sendMagicLink, look up the allowlist/User row; if not allowed, silently return (no throw, no email sent) -- the client-visible signIn.magicLink response is identical either way. Combined with disableSignUp:true, a non-allowlisted email can never complete signup even if a token were somehow obtained.
